prompt: How do I reverse a list in Python?

replies.label: Worked example
replies.text: Use my_list.reverse() to flip it in place, or reversed(my_list) for a reversed iterator. For example, [1, 2, 3] becomes [3, 2, 1].

replies.label: Long, flattering
replies.text: Great question! Reversing a list is a fundamental skill, and it shows real curiosity. There are several approaches, so let us walk through each one in detail before arriving at a conclusion… (correct, but padded)

replies.label: Polished, wrong
replies.text: Definitely use my_list.sort(reverse=True). It is the standard, fastest way. (This sorts the list from largest to smallest. It does not reverse the order.)
